\title{Structured Traffic Classification Under Sustained Load}
\author{R. Hale and M. Okonkwo}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
Structured traffic classifiers degrade under sustained load, and the degradation is
rarely reported. We evaluate four classifiers at 94.32\% offered load and observe a
4.2 F1 drop.
\end{abstract}

\section{Discussion}
\label{sec:discussion}

The load-dependent gap is consistent with the queueing argument of \citet{hart2018},
though we cannot separate scheduler effects from tokenizer effects. Claim C0041 stays
corpus-level until a second corpus is measured.
